Welcome to Baycliff, a family-owned and managed small boutique stay. Set on a sprawling clifftop, we are nestled in a picturesque and unique coastal backdrop. We strive to offer a tranquil and relaxing escape for travelers seeking an intimate, rustic and personalized vacation experience. Our resort has 3 distinctive cottages on a 4 acre private property overlooking the Arabian sea. All 3 cottages look over the cliff and the ocean beyond. The Cottages feature all necessary amenities. Through the cliff, you have access to a seasonal beach and nearby beaches within walking distance.

The cottages are set on a sprawling 4 acre property on the cliff leading up to the ocean
Rains at Baycliff
We are open during the monsoons and we absolutely recommend a stay during this time, provided you love to spend away hours just reading or watching the rains
Edava beaches
The Edava town where Baycliff is set, runs through the Varkala coastline. This is one among a few beaches in Edava, just a few minutes walk by the coastline from Baycliff
Sunset at Baycliff
Walk up from the cottages to the cliff edge to this view.
